_warning: This checkpoint/seed combination was evaluated THREE independent times while reconciling a numerical discrepancy during paper revision, and produced three different results each time. See non_determinism_passes below and Section 4.4 / footnote-dagger of topic4_heuristic_beats_marl.tex. Do not treat any single pass as the ground truth.
root_cause_hypothesis: Real-time physics/ROS message timing jitter in the Gazebo-based evaluation harness, not the --seed argument (which controls Gazebo's PRNG but not wall-clock-dependent message scheduling). Consistent with repeated 'Moved backwards in time, re-publishing joint transforms' warnings observed across these runs. Confirmed NOT policy sampling: all evaluation uses explore=False (greedy actions).
implication: Every single-episode-per-seed number reported elsewhere in this project (including the Protocol B five-world matrix, not yet repeated) carries this same undisclosed uncertainty. Baseline and HighDiscovery were subsequently also re-evaluated to n=9 each (see ablation_baseline_summary.json and ablation_highdiscovery_summary.json) to put all three ablation arms on equal statistical footing.

statistical_test_vs_baseline.interpretation: Not statistically significant at conventional thresholds -- consistent with no real effect once evaluation noise is accounted for, unlike HighDiscovery (t=4.04) vs the same Baseline.
